title: Kanuri people - Wikipedia
text: [14] Kanuri speak varieties of Kanuri, one of the Nilo-Saharan languages. Divisions include the Manga, Tumari, and Bilma dialects of Kanuri and the more distinct Kanembu language. [15] Inheriting the religious and cultural traditions of the Kanem-Bornu state, the Kanuri people are predominantly Sunni Muslim.
